title: Ability cooldown clocks and the predicted stamina spend
oneLine: Per-ability ready-at stamps the client predicts and the worker owns, reconciled by ability_rejected and the pool echo.
topConcern: Both clocks are memory-only; a deploy forgets the worker's cooldowns while the tab keeps its own (deliberate, handoff rule 11).

title: The lunge and the shield bash in flight (dash, deferred strike, swing suppression)
oneLine: A dash toward the lock, a sword strike deferred to arrival, and a window suppressing the ordinary swing's damage sweep.
topConcern: Shield raised mid-lunge is not refused and does not cancel the dash; the strike then lands with blocking:true, the overlap v2.3.2246 forbids.

title: The whirlwind windup (armed ring, strike on the tick)
oneLine: A one-second armed whirlwind on both sides, cancelled by death, zone change or refusal, struck from the worker's position.
topConcern: Worker silently drops a windup on disconnect while the tab plays the full strike look; caps read once at join vs the live kill switch.

title: The shield guard: the client's toggle against the worker's guard break
oneLine: Guard raised or lowered, sent on every move; the worker drains it, breaks it at zero, latches it 3 s.
topConcern: Client BLOCK_COSTS_STAMINA=false: the phone never learns of the worker's 3 s guard break, draws a raised shield, walks at half speed, takes full hits.

title: Sprint (tapped or Shift-held, a predicted stamina drain)
oneLine: Armed, running or stopped sprint with every exit checked per frame; moves marked sp:1 for the worker to pay.
topConcern: Worker refuses sprint steps during a guard break the phone cannot see; clearSprint is a dead export with a misplaced comment.

title: The jump and the double jump's flip
oneLine: One jump or flip record ended by time, death or zone change, with a rest window and a crossing latch.
topConcern: Three hand-kept 'body held' lists: jumpRefusal and the sprint miss the avatar veil and the race hold that the walk honours.

title: The skateboard ride (ask, worker's answer, the phone's own step-off)
oneLine: Board on/off asked of the worker and answered by ride_state; the phone predicts some exits a step ahead.
topConcern: Worker-only exits (a landed hit, duel, harvest, pose, trap) are not predicted, so the phone rolls at 2x for one round trip.

title: The skateboard's rolling loop (decode, play, quiet, free)
oneLine: One looped wheel sound decoded near the board, played while riding, stopped after 1.5 s, freed after 20 s off.
topConcern: free() does not cancel a decode in flight; a late decode re-holds ~0.45 MB until the next tick frees it.

title: The dodge roll, the lunge and the retreat shot
oneLine: A timed roll window owned by the frame loop, paid on the worker by ability_use, which opens its i-frame window.
topConcern: A zone change does not end a roll, so E pressed mid-roll carries the rest of it into the new zone.

title: The swing, the special and the burst
oneLine: Swing cadence clock, 450 ms swing window, 1.5 s special cooldown, queued bow special and the burst's local cooldown stamp.
topConcern: Burst's local cooldown is never un-stamped on a worker refusal; specials fire before the worker's mana answer.

title: The right control's press: tap, hold or drag
oneLine: A press waits as pending for the tap window, then becomes the held attack, the tap's one attack, or nothing.

title: Climbing the vines and jumping up a rise's face (dormant behind ?climb=1)
oneLine: Climb, face-crossing jump, drop back and chest on rises that only exist with the ?climb=1 URL flag.
topConcern: When shipped: faces are walls only on the phone, and the chest's opened state is client-only.

title: Swimming in the Wheel (in, strokes, out, with hysteresis)
oneLine: Swimming decided each frame from five probes round the boots with in/out hysteresis, a flip guard and a teleport rule.
topConcern: A sprinted flip landing over 200 px from take-off counts as a teleport, so landing in water is silent.

title: Element statuses on the player (chill, freeze, hold, daze, wobble, slow, shove, stagger)
oneLine: Time-gated statuses from monster_attack/pvp_hit that slow, hold or bar the player's actions, carried out by the phone.
topConcern: clearElemStatuses is never called: holds, dazes and a shove ride through a zone change or a respawn (bounded by 5 s).

title: Standing back up: the respawn, the stuck-dead watchdog and the death card
oneLine: Death to respawn on the client: the worker's messages, their replay, a 20 s watchdog, and the death card.
topConcern: Three legacy local stand-up copies remain behind a per-zone !_serverMonsters flag, despite respawn.js's 'one copy' rule.

title: A monster's killing blow (direction and size, for its death's pieces)
oneLine: Per-monster last blow with merge and freshness windows, read once when its death animation starts.
topConcern: _deathBlow is not on monsterCarry's carry lists, so a list replace before the kill drops the blow (visual only).

title: A computer's keys: held keys, one-press guards, double tap, wheel step, weapon keys
oneLine: Held-key map, per-key one-press guards, double-tap roll and wheel memories, and the 1/2/3 weapon keys.
topConcern: Key 2 selects the bow slot with no bow owned (key 3 checks the staff): empty slot, no attacks, persisted on the worker.

title: The Enchanter's gem asks: shield gem, weapon gem, take-out
oneLine: Module-level pending asks that hold the gem buttons for 4 s until the worker's result, with no opId.
topConcern: A shield-gem answer slower than 4 s lets a second tap spend a second gem, which replaces and loses the first.

title: The arm's shield, reported to the worker (worn or carried)
oneLine: Local equip of the shield reported by id or signature on every change and every join.
topConcern: A report sent while offline is dropped; the worker treats the old shield as worn until the next join.

title: The one-bite rule in a fight, and the quick-eat pick
oneLine: Page mirror of the worker's one instant heal per 15 s while fighting, synced by eat_refused.
topConcern: noteEatRefused's fight stamp lasts 10 s while the wait can be 15 s, costing one extra refused round trip.

title: A kill's XP flying to the bar
oneLine: One-slot rendezvous of a kill and its XP gain, and a token-counted hold on the bar's +N with failsafes.
topConcern: One waiting slot: a multi-kill before the gains flies a single label.

title: The straight-in road's veil while your bro's pictures are made
oneLine: A veil and a pending-wait count holding the world until the avatar's pictures are ready or 20 s pass.
topConcern: The hold stops the walk but not jumpRefusal's or the sprint's copies of the held list.

title: Emote moves and held poses: the table that times them
oneLine: The declared move table (kind, length, pops) driving the once/hold pose machine in interactions.js and poses.js.
topConcern: sendMove's death test reads S.player.dead/S._dead, which nothing writes; the next frame ends the pose anyway.

title: The harvest gesture's display chase
oneLine: Forward-only pose phase and cook loop count kept on the extraction record, advanced once a frame.

title: The bow special's three arrows (one shared volley record)
oneLine: A volley object electing the burn's owner arrow and the first shove, living with its three arrows.

title: One sword claim per swing against a player
oneLine: Per-swing claim counter keyed by the swing clock, capped at three tries 90 ms apart, per target.

title: The legs' pace: the held speed quantum with hysteresis
oneLine: A held quantised ground speed per figure with a dead band, timing the jog loop to the stride.

title: An ability strike's look: bash pose, whirlwind vortex, rings
oneLine: Short stamped visual windows for a strike, reaped by their renderers and cleared with the zone-local list.
topConcern: _whirlFx is reaped only once the vortex sheet has frames; _abilityFx is written and never read.
